entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2025-05-28
entry.content:
Google.Area120.Tables.V1Alpha1 version 2.0.0-alpha14

more release process testing

Google.Cloud.StorageTransfer.V1 version 2.9.0

New features

  • Support Azure federated identity
  • Support BYOSA

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for message ObjectConditions is changed
  • A comment for field list_url in message .google.storagetransfer.v1.HttpData is changed
  • A comment for field overwrite_objects_already_existing_in_sink in message .google.storagetransfer.v1.TransferOptions is changed
  • A comment for field end_time_of_day in message .google.storagetransfer.v1.Schedule is changed
  • A comment for enum value COPY in enum LoggableAction is changed

Google.Cloud.Dlp.V2 version 4.18.0

New features

  • Add Dataplex Catalog action for discovery configs
  • Add a project ID to table reference so that org parents can create single table discovery configs.
  • New fields for data profile finding.

Documentation improvements

  • Various doc revisions

Google.Cloud.Commerce.Consumer.Procurement.V1 version 1.5.0

Bug fixes

  • An existing google.api.http annotation http_uri is changed for method UpdateLicensePool in service LicenseManagementService

Google.Cloud.Bigtable.V2 version 3.18.0

Bug fixes

  • ReadRow/s respects rowsLimit and retries on Aborted exception. Fixes TestReadRows_Retry_PausedScan, TestReadRows_NoRetry_ErrorAfterLastRow, and TestReadRow_Generic_DeadlineExceeded. (#14794)

Google.Cloud.AIPlatform.V1Beta1 version 1.0.0-beta32

New features

  • Introduce RAG as context/memory store for Gemini Live API
  • Add ImportIndex to IndexService

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for message RagFileParsingConfig is updated.
  • A comment for field global_max_embedding_requests_per_min in message .google.cloud.aiplatform.v1beta1.ImportRagFilesConfig is updated.
